Assumptions:
- The Myagang–Gajuri and Kakani–Gajuri roads are treated as unusable because of the fast-running floodwater and the swept-away truck.
- Panchakanya school is not used as a drop-off point, since it is not designated.
- Gajuri is reachable only via Panchakanya, so a separate trip there would cost about 146 minutes to save 60 in penalties. Deferring those three adults is cheaper.
- The four adults at Jwalamukhi cost 80 minutes to rescue, the same as their deferral penalty. I chose to rescue them.
